name: Colosseum of Wishes — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Oval open court with concentric stepped terraces, repeated cream/gold arched facade bays, several exterior entry stairs, blue drapes and a central blue/gold star medallion. Inner perimeter is planted; source mini-plan confirms oval ring circulation. Hidden layout inference: Choose one clear main arrival, let the inner ring circulate continuously, and connect two secondary stairs to quieter garden overlooks. Keep central wishing court open and readable; place existing wishing objects at discrete edge niches rather than turning every arch into a new room or music venue. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B08-DETAIL-001 — Colosseum of Wishes — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need curved arcade/wall repeat and end joints, stair/ring landing, radial paving wedge and terrace edge modules. Star mosaic, lantern, drapery and gold lattice already exist. Meadow flowers/oak/hazel near outer approach; swallows/pollinators proposed. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
